description: AGMH handheld bombs, barrel bombs, and throwables for Items Forge (AoE save / attack Activities).

items.name: Flash Bomb
entries: As an action, light this bomb and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat its saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Sonic Bomb
entries: As an action, light this bomb and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away, creating an ear-piercing sound on impact. Each creature within 30 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition deafened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
entries: As an action, throw this bomb at a point up to 40 feet away. One round after it lands, it emits a cloud of smoke that creates a heavily obscured area in a 20-foot radius. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the smoke in 4 rounds; a strong wind (20 or more miles per hour) disperses it in 1 round.
Foundry: place the 20-ft radius template on use (treat the delay narratively or wait one round before placing).

items.name: Poison Smoke Bomb
entries: As an action, throw this bomb at a point up to 40 feet away. One round after it lands, it emits poisonous smoke (heavily obscured, 20-foot radius). A creature that starts its turn in the smoke must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. Wind disperses as Smoke Bomb. A poisoned creature can repeat its saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Foundry: Throw places the cloud template; Use Gas runs the Con save against creatures in the area (proxy for starting a turn in the smoke).

items.name: Sm Barrel-Bomb
entries: Setting fire to a sm barrel-bomb causes it to explode, dealing {@dice 3d6} fire damage to creatures within 10 feet of it. A successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage.

items.name: Lg Barrel-Bomb
entries: Setting fire to a lg barrel-bomb causes it to explode, dealing {@dice 7d6} fire damage to creatures within 10 feet of it. A successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage.

items.name: Bounce Bomb
entries: Setting fire to a bounce bomb causes it to launch 100 feet into the air and explode. It explodes early if it impacts a creature or object before reaching its maximum height, dealing {@dice 3d6} fire damage to creatures within 10 feet of it. A successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage.
Foundry: choose the explosion point (up to 100 feet up / along the path) when you Ignite.

items.name: Dung Bomb
entries: As an action, throw this bomb up to 60 feet. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the dung bomb as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell for 1 hour and disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration for 1 minute. If the target is a creature with an Intelligence score of 8 or lower, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed away from you.
Foundry: attack + stench AE are automated; the Int 8 flee save is manual.

items.name: Tranq Bomb
entries: As an action, throw this bomb up to 40 feet. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object (improvised weapon). On a hit, roll {@dice 5d8}. If the target is below one-fourth of its maximum hit points and its remaining hit points are below the number rolled, it falls {@condition unconscious} for 24 hours.

You can hit a creature with up to three tranq bombs or ammo, adding the totals. After a third miss of the threshold, the creature is immune for 24 hours. Creatures without a capture loot table are immune.
Foundry: attack and 5d8 roll are automated; apply unconscious / stacking / immunity manually.

items.name: Paintball
entries: When you throw this item at a creature, make a ranged weapon attack. On a hit, the creature is marked for 1 hour. While marked you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to find it.
